items.lead: Backend-focused engineer working across cloud services, the data platform and in-vehicle edge systems. I also contribute to architecture decisions, technical standards and system design.
bullets: Design and build microservices with Python and FastAPI on AWS, using event-driven architectures focused on decoupling and scalability.
Build a telemetry ingestion data platform with AWS Kinesis and Lambda functions that trigger downstream events.
Implement the in-vehicle edge interface with LVGL and an offline navigation component with Valhalla-based routing for low-connectivity environments.
Develop web frontends with React (SPA) and Next.js.
Create agentic engineering workflows with Claude Code, specialized agents and reusable skills.

items.lead: Full-stack internship focused on accessibility, SEO and performance for Telefónica's digital products, built on the Mística Design System.
bullets: Designed and built a full-stack web accessibility analysis platform (React, Express, MongoDB) with automated audit reporting.
Developed and maintained web applications with Next.js and React.
Implemented accessibility (WCAG) and SEO improvements across digital products.
Conducted technical audits and Web Performance Optimization (WPO).

about.heading: About
narrative: I’m a Software Engineer focused on backend and distributed systems, building scalable cloud services with Python, FastAPI and AWS.
At Génexys I build microservices and event-driven architectures, work on offline geospatial navigation for low-connectivity environments, and create agentic engineering workflows with Claude Code.
I enjoy designing systems that are simple, reliable and built to scale.
